name: powerpages-traditional-site
description: Power Pages Traditional (non-code) site toolkit: pp-* skills for provisioning, building, integrating, and securing Power Pages sites on the enhanced Dataverse data model (mspp_* tables + powerpagecomponent). Content via the Dataverse Web API: web pages, page/web templates, web files, content snippets, navigation (web links, site markers, redirects), basic/multistep forms and lists, server logic, Liquid, Web API. Security: web roles, table/column permissions, page access rules, headers/CSP, WAF, security review. Lifecycle via pac CLI: provisioning, data-model migration, download/upload, Bootstrap 3 to 5, cache flush. Includes two read-only agents (security-auditor, web-template-architect) and references grounded in Microsoft Learn plus community best practices. Works in Claude Code and GitHub Copilot (CLI and VS Code).
